comments.author: Attila the Hung
comments.body_html:
You can with SVM, actually. Under “advanced features” copy & paste this into the “default IIC” section:

5c0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde1:MaxHpResource:2 5c0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde3:MaxHpResource:2 5c0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde5:MaxHpResource:2 5c0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde6:MaxHpResource:2

5c0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde1 is APEX, 5c0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde3 is AEGIS, 5c0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde5 is IRON, and 5c0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde6 is ARGUS. I excluded GRAFT since like OP said, it has five uses, but if you want to add or take away uses from it, its id is 5c0a1b2c3d4e5f6789abcde8.

edit: sorry this is really sloppy; I’m bad with formatting. I’m not sure how much it matters, but place the stim ID’s in the IIC section top to bottom and not left to right like they appear in my comment.
